Druid - Kyoufu no Tobira.name: Druid
Druid - Kyoufu no Tobira.summary: Druid is an arcade-style dungeon crawl where the player controls the last of the Great Druids on a quest to save the land of Belorn by destroying the four demon princes lurking in the dungeons of the evil lich Acamantor.

Fairy Pinball - Yousei Tachi no Pinball.name: Fairy Pinball: Yousei-tachi no Pinball
Fairy Pinball - Yousei Tachi no Pinball.summary: An adult pinball game in which you can play two tables and try to get a high enough score to watch a girl undress. The two tables are a space based one called Asteroid, and a naval war based one called Midway.

Meikyuu Jiin Dababa.name: Meikyuu Jiin Dababa
Meikyuu Jiin Dababa.summary:
A young man's significant-other is kidnapped by an evil wizard. He must then tackle the four areas of the labyrinth temple of Dababa to rescue her.

In order to accomplish this task, the player cannot simple move across the floor. Rather, the player and all of the enemies hop from one square tile to another, throughout the game.
